reviews.text: I scheduled an appointment yesterday for my dog and girl who picked up the phone is going to say my dog paperwork vaccine isn’t up to date so I call the vet and they said it’s up to date I call again the manager picks up I tell her it’s up to date that the girl doesn’t know what she is doing the manager says she does that’s why we hire her turns out it is up to date and now I put a deposit but I don’t see it taken from my account so I call the next day and they put me on hold for like 20 minutes when I finally spoke to someone I asked about my appointment they say the deposit didn’t go thru so gave my information again now my dog is scheduled for an appointment very unprofessional and I’m 100% they don’t do the complete job like teeth cleaning and nail trimming
Love how caring and loving you all treat my Narla and I.
We’ve been taking our mini cockapoo here for 3 years. They always do the BEST job and she looks perfectly cute every time! Plus they are so kind!

We have been bringing our mini schnauzer here for 6 months (every month) and they are the best! We tried a bunch of different groomers in the city for 3 years before finding The Bark Shoppe and now we don't take our pup anywhere else!
Thank you for your rating! - Bernadette, Manager at The Bark Shoppe
Consistently GREAT grooming! Jeff and Bernadette are gentle with our little guy, and he always comes home, clean, handsome, and happy.

Been coming here for a long time now (years) for Anubis’ cut. Pretty straightforward experience every time. Check-in, meet groomer, discuss your cut, then leave them your pet. Staff have treated me and my dog well and kind. Groomer(s) does what I ask to the best of their abilities. Never had any major issues.
I SO SO LOVE THE BARK SHOPPE THANK YOU FOR ALWAYS HOOKING MASE UP HE APPRECIATE IT ENJOY YOUR SUMMER GUYS

We LOVE The Bark Shoppe! We've been coming here for 2 years for grooming, day care, and boarding services with our cockapoo Obi. The entire team takes amazing care of our pup.  Whenever we come to the block where TBS is located, Obi takes off running towards the door and can't wait to go inside and see his friends! For daycare/boarding, they send updates with pictures during the day which we always appreciate.   He always comes back from his grooms looking super handsome.  We're very thankful for all of their care.
Bernadette is the best she takes care of Mia very well… Mia also smells good and look so pretty when I pick her up.
